title: ‘CM Vijay’ WhatsApp call promises Rs 11 lakh aid, Bengaluru man loses Rs 1 lakh

reports.title: ‘CM Vijay’ WhatsApp call promises Rs 11 lakh aid, Bengaluru man loses Rs 1 lakh

summary:
A 29 year old security guard in Bengaluru, Ratikanta Giri, lost more than Rs 1.04 lakh after a WhatsApp video call used an AI deepfake of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay. On Sept 9, the caller promised Rs 11 lakh in aid and said a manager would arrange a transfer from Vijay's foreign account. The fraudster then demanded fees, including Rs 5,000, Rs 18,000, and over Rs 50,000 from someone posing as a CBI officer. Giri paid through a digital payment app.

When the fraudsters asked for another Rs 50,000, Giri refused and realized he had been cheated. He contacted the cybercrime helpline 1930 and then approached Byappanahalli police. A case has been registered under the Information Technology Act. Police said this was the first such case reported in the city and urged people not to trust such calls or make payments based on them.
